<div><span class="kicker">About Summax</span><h1>Practical thinking for spaces that matter.</h1></div>
<p>Summax Global Investment is an Abuja-based team of allied building professionals working across design, construction, renovation and project delivery.</p>
</div>

<div class="about-statement"><span class="section-index">01</span><div><h2>Start with the site. Stay close to the brief.</h2><p>Since 2014, Summax has brought together the conversations, drawings, coordination and site work needed to move a building project forward. The approach is direct: understand what the work must do, then make careful decisions that support it.</p></div></div>

<div class="about-objectives"><div><span class="kicker">Objectives</span><h2>Solutions shaped around the client.</h2></div><div><p>Summax draws upon its experience and expertise to understand each client’s identity, needs and objectives, then develops creative solutions specific to the project.</p><p>Whether the work involves a new facility, renovation, relocation, expansion or consolidation, the team aims to serve as a trusted project adviser—listening carefully, communicating clearly and working toward results that meet a high standard.</p><p class="audience-note"><strong>Project relationships</strong><span>Private developers · corporate bodies · religious institutions · governmental institutions</span></p></div></div>

<div class="about-columns">
<div><span class="kicker">What we do</span><h2>One team across the building journey.</h2></div>
<div class="about-services"><div><strong>Design and planning</strong><p>Site evaluation, building design, interiors and planting.</p></div><div><strong>Construction and supervision</strong><p>Building works, coordination and site supervision.</p></div><div><strong>Renovation and maintenance</strong><p>Renewal, repair and continued care for existing spaces.</p></div><div><strong>Project support</strong><p>Project management, real estate, furniture and ICT services.</p></div></div>
</div>
